name: Columns
description: A collection of Column objects that represent the columns in a table.
example:
Dim ColCount, sl, sh As Integer

With ActivePresentation
    For sl = 1 To .Slides.Count
        For sh = 1 To .Slides(sl).Shapes.Count
            If .Slides(sl).Shapes(sh).HasTable Then
                ColCount = .Slides(sl).Shapes(sh) _
                    .Table.Columns.Count
                MsgBox "Shape " & sh & " on slide " & sl & _
                    " contains the first table and has " & _
                    ColCount & " columns."
                Exit Sub
            End If
        Next
    Next
End With

properties.name: Count

properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single Column object from the specified Columns collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the single Column object in the collection to be returned.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new column to an existing table. Returns a Column object that represents the new table column.

parameters.name: BeforeColumn
parameters.description: The index number that specifies the table column before which the new column will be inserted.
